notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-sn -PE --disable-arp-ping --packet-trace tests ICMP echo specifically against a single host. Disabling ARP forces ICMP so the ICMP-level firewall behavior is observable. --packet-trace shows every packet sent/received for verification.

=== DIAGNOSTIC VALUE ===
--packet-trace + --reason together: shows exactly what packet triggered 'host up' determination and why. Essential when host discovery results are unexpected or when documenting discovery method for a report.

=== FILTERED ICMP ===
No response to ICMP echo does not mean host is down — firewall may be silently dropping pings. Hosts that appear 'inactive' in ICMP scans may respond to TCP probes.
